vargottama.description: Planet in same sign in D1 and D9

pushkara_navamsha.description: Special navamshas that amplify good results
pushkara_navamsha.effect: Amplifies auspicious results, protection from harm

d10_dashamsha.description: D10 Dashamsha chart reveals career, profession, achievements, public reputation, and karmic work
d10_dashamsha.significance: Shows professional destiny, work environment, career success, and how one serves society

aries.characteristics: Natural authority, independent work, leadership roles

cancer.characteristics: Emotional intelligence in work, public-facing roles

scorpio.characteristics: Emotional intensity in work, hidden professions

gemini.characteristics: Mental energy in work, technical skills

10th_lord_analysis.description: 10th lord in D10 reveals career nature

career_timing.description: Dasha of D10 10th lord or planets in D10 10th brings career events

benefic_aspects_to_10th.description: Benefic aspects to 10th house in D10 ensure career success

malefic_in_d10.description: Malefics in D10 show challenges and strength
malefic_in_d10.principle: Well-placed malefics give career strength through challenges

d2_hora.description: D2 Hora chart reveals wealth, financial capacity, and material prosperity
d2_hora.significance: Shows wealth potential, earning capacity, and financial destiny. Only two signs matter: Sun's hora (Leo) and Moon's hora (Cancer).

cancer.significance: Earns through real estate, food, agriculture
Earns through counseling, food business, writing
Earns through teaching, banking, family business
Earns through hospitality, interior design, cooking
Slow wealth through public service, social work

leo.significance: Slow wealth through government, engineering, labor
Sudden gains through technology, foreign authority
Wealth from spiritual or occult sources

special_rules.malefics_in_own_hora: Wealth through hard work and competition

d3_drekkana.description: D3 Drekkana chart reveals siblings, courage, vitality, and co-born relationships
d3_drekkana.significance: Shows sibling relationships, personal courage, sexual vitality, and short journeys

special_rules.3rd_lord_analysis: 3rd lord in D3 shows sibling fortune and personal courage
special_rules.mars_in_d3: Mars placement in D3 directly indicates level of personal courage and vitality

d4_chaturthamsha.description: D4 Chaturthamsha chart reveals property, fixed assets, fortune, and destiny
d4_chaturthamsha.significance: Shows property ownership, fixed assets, vehicles, home environment, and overall fortune

key_principles.4th_house: Primary indicator of property and home in D4
key_principles.4th_lord: Its placement shows source and nature of property

planet_summary.saturn: Old property, inherited land, property through hard work

d7_saptamsha.description: D7 Saptamsha chart reveals children, progeny, and creative potential
d7_saptamsha.significance: Shows children's nature, number of children, fertility, and creative output

key_principles.5th_house: Primary indicator of children in D7
key_principles.5th_lord: Its placement shows children's fortune and nature
key_principles.jupiter_placement: Natural significator of children, its D7 position is crucial

planet_summary.sun: Authoritative children, possible son, leadership qualities in children
planet_summary.moon: Nurturing children, possible daughter, emotionally connected children
planet_summary.mars: Energetic and courageous children, competitive children
planet_summary.mercury: Intelligent and communicative children, educated children
planet_summary.jupiter: Wise and fortunate children, spiritual children, many children
planet_summary.venus: Beautiful and artistic children, loving children
planet_summary.saturn: Delayed children, disciplined children, children through hardship
planet_summary.ketu: Spiritual children, detachment from children, past-life child karma

d12_dwadashamsha.description: D12 Dwadashamsha chart reveals parents, lineage, and ancestral karma
d12_dwadashamsha.significance: Shows relationship with parents, parental fortune, lineage blessings, and ancestral patterns

planet_summary.sun: Father's nature and authority, parental ego, lineage pride
planet_summary.moon: Mother's nature and nurturing, parental emotions, lineage feelings
planet_summary.mars: Parental conflicts, courage from parents, property inheritance
planet_summary.mercury: Parental education, family communication, intellectual lineage
planet_summary.jupiter: Parental wisdom, family dharma, blessed lineage
planet_summary.venus: Parental love, family beauty, artistic lineage
planet_summary.saturn: Parental hardship, ancestral karma, duty to parents
planet_summary.ketu: Spiritual lineage, past-life parental karma, detachment from parents

d16_shodashamsha.description: D16 Shodashamsha chart reveals vehicles, conveyances, comforts, and mental happiness
d16_shodashamsha.significance: Shows vehicles, physical comforts, mental peace, and sukha (happiness)

key_principles.4th_house: Primary indicator of vehicles and comforts
key_principles.venus_placement: Natural significator of comforts and luxury vehicles

planet_summary.sun: Government vehicles, prestigious conveyances, authority-based comforts
planet_summary.moon: Comfortable vehicles, mental peace, emotional happiness
planet_summary.mars: Powerful vehicles, sports cars, mechanical comforts
planet_summary.mercury: Communication devices, business vehicles, intellectual comforts
planet_summary.jupiter: Luxurious vehicles, spiritual comforts, wisdom-based happiness
planet_summary.venus: Beautiful vehicles, artistic comforts, luxury and pleasure
planet_summary.saturn: Old vehicles, basic comforts, happiness through discipline
planet_summary.ketu: Detachment from vehicles, spiritual happiness, simple comforts

d20_vimshamsha.description: D20 Vimshamsha chart reveals spiritual life, upasana (worship), and religious inclination
d20_vimshamsha.significance: Shows spiritual path, form of worship, religious practices, and spiritual progress

planet_summary.sun: Worship of Surya, Gayatri sadhana, fire rituals, Vedic spirituality
planet_summary.moon: Worship of Devi, bhakti path, devotional practices, water rituals
planet_summary.mars: Worship of Hanuman/Kartikeya, tantric practices, kundalini yoga
planet_summary.mercury: Worship of Vishnu, mantra meditation, scriptural study, japa yoga
planet_summary.jupiter: Worship of Brihaspati/guru, Vedantic study, teaching dharma
planet_summary.venus: Worship of Lakshmi, artistic devotion, temple arts, beautiful worship
planet_summary.saturn: Worship of Shani/Kali, discipline-based spirituality, seva yoga
planet_summary.rahu: Foreign spiritual traditions, unconventional worship, Buddhist/Jain paths
planet_summary.ketu: Worship of Ganesha, moksha practices, past-life spiritual skills, liberation

d24_chaturvimshamsha.description: D24 Chaturvimshamsha chart reveals education, learning, academic achievements
d24_chaturvimshamsha.significance: Shows educational attainment, field of study, academic success, and knowledge acquisition

planet_summary.sun: Government education, political science, administration studies
planet_summary.moon: Psychology, nursing education, hospitality training, emotional intelligence
planet_summary.mars: Engineering, military training, sports education, surgery
planet_summary.mercury: Commerce, communication, IT education, languages, mathematics
planet_summary.jupiter: Philosophy, law, theology, higher education, teaching
planet_summary.venus: Arts education, music, dance, fashion design, beauty studies
planet_summary.saturn: Traditional education, engineering, mining studies, slow but deep learning
planet_summary.rahu: Foreign education, technology, unconventional studies, online learning
planet_summary.ketu: Spiritual education, occult studies, past-life knowledge, intuitive learning

d27_nakshatramsha.description: D27 Nakshatramsha (Bhamsha) chart reveals innate strengths, weaknesses, and character
d27_nakshatramsha.significance: Shows fundamental character strengths, natural abilities, and intrinsic personality

planet_summary.moon: Emotional strength, nurturing ability, intuitive power
planet_summary.mercury: Intellectual strength, communication ability, analytical power
planet_summary.jupiter: Wisdom strength, teaching ability, philosophical depth
planet_summary.rahu: Innovation strength, foreign abilities, unconventional talent
planet_summary.ketu: Spiritual strength, intuitive abilities, past-life talents

d30_trimshamsha.description: D30 Trimshamsha chart reveals misfortunes, evils, dangers, and negative karma
d30_trimshamsha.significance: Shows potential misfortunes, nature of suffering, health dangers, and karmic difficulties

planet_summary.sun: Misfortune through authority, government problems, ego-related suffering
planet_summary.moon: Mental suffering, emotional misfortune, mother-related difficulties
planet_summary.mercury: Nervous disorders, communication problems, business losses
planet_summary.jupiter: Moral failures, dharmic violations, teacher-related misfortune
planet_summary.venus: Relationship suffering, sexual problems, luxury-related misfortune
planet_summary.saturn: Chronic suffering, karmic debts, loneliness, structural problems
planet_summary.rahu: Foreign dangers, poison, deception, technology-related misfortune
planet_summary.ketu: Spiritual confusion, mysterious ailments, past-life karmic misfortune

special_rules.note: D30 is primarily used for female charts to assess character and moral integrity
special_rules.malefics_in_trikona: Indicates specific types of suffering based on sign

d60_shashtiamsha.description: D60 Shashtiamsha chart reveals past-life karma, overall destiny, and deepest karmic patterns
d60_shashtiamsha.significance: Most important divisional chart after D9. Reveals past-life karma that shapes current life destiny. Each of 60 divisions has a specific deity and nature.

key_principles.strong_planets: Positive past-life karma bringing current blessings
key_principles.weak_planets: Negative past-life karma causing current challenges

planet_summary.sun: Past-life authority karma, soul-level leadership, father's karmic connection
planet_summary.moon: Past-life emotional karma, mother's karmic connection, mental destiny
planet_summary.mars: Past-life warrior karma, courage patterns, property destiny
planet_summary.mercury: Past-life intellectual karma, communication destiny, business patterns
planet_summary.jupiter: Past-life wisdom karma, dharmic destiny, children's karmic connection
planet_summary.venus: Past-life love karma, relationship destiny, artistic patterns
planet_summary.saturn: Past-life duty karma, service destiny, suffering patterns
planet_summary.rahu: Past-life desire karma, material destiny, foreign patterns
planet_summary.ketu: Past-life spiritual karma, liberation destiny, moksha patterns

shashtiamsha_types.importance: Even a slight birth time error changes D60, so accurate birth time is critical
